component.name: ProxyZip
component.summary: Capture, inspect and debug HTTP(S) traffic

description.p: ProxyZip sits between your applications and the internet, decrypts HTTPS with a certificate authority that stays on your computer, and shows every request, response and WebSocket message in real time.
Pause and edit requests, mock responses, rewrite traffic, script it in JavaScript, decode Protobuf, gRPC and GraphQL, and let AI assistants inspect captures through MCP.
